'''Maria Gardfjell''' (born 1965)<ref name="profile_riksdagen_se">{{Cite web|title=Maria Gardfjell|url=https://www.riksdagen.se/sv/ledamoter-partier/ledamot/_d9a13d2e-85ec-4c59-af10-773ff99b8eb1|access-date=15 February 2021|website=Riksdagen.se|language=sv}}</ref> is a Swedish politician. From 2018 to 2022 she served as [[List of members of the Riksdag, 2018–2022|Member of the Riksdag]] representing the constituency of [[Uppsala County (Riksdag constituency)|Uppsala County]].<ref name="de_blir_nya_i_riksdagen_2018">{{Cite news|date=14 September 2018|title=De blir nya i riksdagen|language=sv|work=SVT Nyheter|url=https://www.svt.se/nyheter/lokalt/uppsala/de-har-kryssats-in-i-riksdagen|access-date=16 February 2021}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Radio |first=Sveriges |date=2022-01-15 |title=Gardfjell (MP) hoppar av riksdagsvalet - P4 Uppland |url=https://www.sverigesradio.se/artikel/lokal-mp-topp-hoppar-av-riksdagsvalet |access-date=2025-10-26 |website=www.sverigesradio.se |language=sv}}</ref>

She is a biologist and geoscientist.<ref name="maria_gardfjell_blir_vice_2018">{{Cite news|date=28 September 2018|title=Maria Gardfjell (MP) blir vice ordförande i riksdagens miljö- och jordbruksutskott|language=sv|work=news.cision.com/Miljöpartiet de gröna|url=https://news.cision.com/se/miljopartiet-de-grona/r/maria-gardfjell--mp--blir-vice-ordforande-i-riksdagens-miljo--och-jordbruksutskott,c2629925|access-date=15 February 2021}}</ref>
